headline: Frontlines Shift as Nevish Linn Mercy Surge
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the Nevish Line has erupted: the most recent hour shows Colonial losses climbing to thirty‑six per hour and Warden to forty‑four, with enlistments jumping to twenty, all marked as accelerating. Linn Mercy, which spiked earlier, has eased in the last hour — Colonial casualties flat, Warden falling — yet the six‑hour toll remains above two hundred Colonial and four hundred Warden dead. Weathered Expanse stays fiercely contested, adding sixteen Colonial and fourteen Warden dead in two hours while the one‑hour trend still signals accelerating Colonial losses. Callahans Passage continues its grinding exchange, posting two hundred nine Colonial and one hundred fifty‑six Warden casualties in the latest two‑hour window and a rising enlistment rate. Marban Hollow, though modest in blood, shows enlistments accelerating to eighteen per hour and a recent uptick in Warden losses. Mooring County has surged dramatically, recording nine hundred fifty‑eight Colonial and one thousand two hundred nine Warden dead in two hours with enlistments leaping to seventy‑nine per hour. Overall enlistments are rising across all active sectors, feeding fresh manpower into the contested fronts.
